name: Architecture
note: Where each part runs and which chain it writes to. Two chains: the ROOT chain (ed25519, hash-linked, .timmy/receipts/runs.jsonl, also the one bus) and the EDGE chains in CUSTODY_KV, anchored daily into the root.

rows.label: companion
rows.note: HTML5 bundle, receipted by lanes/defold; badge from the share

rows.label: companion page
rows.note: src/companion: mirrors the TUI, pushes the bus, serves /slate3d

rows.label: Slate 3D
rows.note: mission boards as scenes; reads, never spawns work

rows.label: root chain
rows.note: every seal; event envelopes appended beside receipts (the one bus)

rows.label: edge chains
rows.note: custody.tap per unit, code runs per run id

rows.label: daily head
rows.note: walks every edge chain, publishes head:<date>; anchored as chain.anchor in root

rows.label: seal from a worktree
rows.note: cwd = main; store-pin preflight; never from a subdirectory

rows.label: sync room
rows.note: runs/events contract; reads public, writes need the caller token

rows.label: defold
rows.note: bob pinned to the engine, build server, seals defold.build with every hash
